entries.5293b1d9201ca80b: Tenants and users of commercial facilities
entries.a576052ef03cc651: This is a category not included in the reportable segments, and includes the restaurant business (Five Star and C.O.M.) and real estate development, sales and building maintenance in China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥16,793 million, of which the restaurant business accounted for ¥16,583 million.
entries.d474025243953499: A company that operates general supermarkets mainly in Shiga Prefecture, selling food, clothing and daily necessities to local customers.
entries.e82215500e12cb82: The business leases stores, operates commercial facilities and provides building maintenance and other services. Besto-ne prepares the cooked rice and side dishes sold by Heiwado and processes meat and fresh fish. National Maintenance handles building management, and Takeo Ekikita Parking manages store parking lots. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6,867 million.
